anomalies.observed: In the "WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES" block the TF-Luna LiDAR footprint/socket is drawn fully wired: PR2 ("PB_LiDAR") sits next to its 1.25 mm connector H9 ("PB_1.25mm") and its pins run to +5V, GND and onto the board's main, non-isolated I2C bus (the same SDA/SCL nets that go to the ESP32-C6 and to the EZO-RTD).
anomalies.expected: The specification states the LiDAR is schematic documentation only: "its pins are 'free' and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net." Water level in this design is sensed by the HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor and the two float switches, and the LiDAR must be left unconnected.

evidence.quote: its pins are "free" and it is marked `on_board: no` / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net
WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES — "Water Height Sensor": PR2 PB_LiDAR with H9 PB_1.25mm terminating on +5V, SCL, SDA, GND (sheet 1)

anomalies.impact: The LiDAR is placed on the main I2C bus that already carries the EZO-RTD and the optional BME280/BH1750 devices. If the module is fitted it adds an unplanned I2C device (address/bus-loading contention) and changes the board's water-level interface relative to the intended design.

anomalies.observed: The ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch is drawn as T4, an AO3400A (small SOT-23 N-MOSFET). The AON6407 8-DFN N-MOSFET that the BOM/spec assigns to this position is instead used for the input "Reverse polarity protection" device (T2) in the POWER TRAIN block.
anomalies.expected: Spec: "T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch; gate driven through R10 (100 Ω), pre-driven via T4 (BT3904)." The AON6407 should be the valve's pass device, and only one AO3400A exists in the r2 BOM (T5).

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch
r2 drops to a smaller discrete-switch set (T1/T4 BT3904 ×2, T2 IRLR2905, T3 AON6407, T5 AO3400A ×1)
MAIN PUMP & VALVE DRIVERS — ATO-valve driver drawn with "T4 AO3400A"; POWER TRAIN drawn with "T2 AON6407" reverse-polarity MOSFET (sheet 1)

anomalies.impact: The 24 V solenoid is switched by a much smaller device than intended (SOT-23 ~5.7 A vs 8-DFN AON6407), cutting current/thermal and Vds margin on the ATO output, while the reverse-polarity position uses an oversized DFN part. The board functions but with degraded ruggedness/rating on the valve switch.

parsed.summary: The drawing deviates from the intended r2 design in two places: the TF-Luna LiDAR is wired onto the main I2C bus even though the design is documented as leaving it unconnected, and the ATO-valve low-side switch is an AO3400A instead of the specified AON6407 (the AON6407 appears instead as the input reverse-polarity FET).
